author: reek
body: The depth pass of shadow mapping. The light is an orbiting directional source; this pass renders the scene from the light's point of view into a 1024x1024 orthographic shadow map. One thread per shadow-map texel casts a ray along the light direction from the light plane, finds the nearest of three spheres, and stores the hit distance (or a large sentinel). The camera pass reads this buffer to decide what is in shadow. Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: The light direction orbits; its basis is derived from world-up. The texel maps to a start point on the light plane; the ray marches along the light direction.
